subject: PeakWell SIG/CAIQ: scheduling call and evidence transfer
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@peakwell.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@peakwell.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T14:23:00Z
Subject: PeakWell SIG/CAIQ: scheduling call and evidence transfer

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking time to help with our SIG/CAIQ intake. We'd like to run through the questionnaire and establish owners for evidence transfer. Can your team do a 45-minute call next week? We prefer Tuesday or Wednesday morning PT.

High level agenda:
- Walk through SIG top-level questions where we need clarification (data residency, key management)
- Confirm list of artifacts and owners
- Set delivery dates for evidence (SOC2 summary, network diagrams, config screenshots)

I've attached our initial spreadsheet with flagged rows (PeakWell-SIG-Answers-v1.xlsx).

Best,
Alex
Sr. Security Program Manager
PeakWell Therapeutics
Attachments: PeakWell-SIG-Answers-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@peakwell.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: PeakWell SIG/CAIQ: scheduling call and evidence transfer

Hi Alex —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear agenda. Tuesday (2026-10-27) 10:00 AM PT or Wednesday (2026-10-28) 09:00 AM PT both work for our security intake team. If either is good for you we'll lock it in and I'll invite Jonas (our controls lead) for the discussion around evidence owners.

Pre-call ask from our side:
- Can you mark the rows in the spreadsheet that are 'must-have' for your procurement review vs 'nice-to-have'?
- If you have any compliance frameworks beyond SIG/CAIQ (e.g., specific SOC2 trust services categories) call that out in the sheet.

I'll attach a short SOC2 summary we can share (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and a calendar invite once we pick a time.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@peakwell.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@peakwell.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T17:10:00Z
Subject: Re: PeakWell SIG/CAIQ: scheduling call and evidence transfer

Hi Priya —

Thanks. We can do Tuesday 2026-10-27 at 10:00 AM PT. I've updated the spreadsheet to flag 'must-have' rows and added a note column for a couple of items. Lina will join from procurement; she'll own receipt of the final artifacts.

One quick gating question for the call: do you support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for model logs or is KMS-only managed by Redwood? If we can get a brief answer before the call it will speed things up.

Regards,
Alex

--Forwarded attachment: PeakWell-SIG-Answers-v1.xlsx--
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@peakwell.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z
Subject: Re: PeakWell SIG/CAIQ: scheduling call and evidence transfer

Alex — confirmed for Tue 10/27 10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite sent to the thread.

Quick answers to pre-call questions:
- BYOK (customer-managed keys): For hosted customers we offer KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) that allow customer-managed keys for persistent data at rest. For Dedicated/Private deployments we support HSM/KMS configurations as part of the deployment. We'll cover specifics on the call and include a short diagram.

During the call we'll review the SIG rows you flagged. Jonas will map each 'must-have' to an evidence owner and a delivery date (target: within 10 business days for most artifacts).

Attached for your procurement team: a one-page evidence checklist and links to SOC2 artifact examples. Also sharing our preferred secure transfer options (SharePoint/Drive link + access policy or direct sFTP).

Attachments: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF, 30KB)
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_peakwell_SIG_docs

See you on Tue,
Priya
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference
